question: What is the ratio of the interior angle of a regular hexagon to the interior angle of a regular 12-sided polygon (dodecagon)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Each interior angle of a regular polygon is given by 180° − (360° ÷ n), where n is the number of sides.

Interior angle of a regular hexagon (n = 6) = 180° − 60° = 120°.

Interior angle of a regular 12-sided polygon (n = 12) = 180° − 30° = 150°.

Required Ratio = 120° : 150° = 4 : 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides of regular hexagon (n₁) = 6

Number of sides of regular dodecagon (n₂) = 12

**Formula Used:**

Interior angle of a regular n-sided polygon = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

 
 Hexagon 120° 
 Dodecagon 150° Interior Angle Ratio = 120° : 150° = 4 : 5 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Interior angle of a regular hexagon = [(6 − 2) × 180°] ÷ 6

⇒ Interior angle of a regular hexagon = [4 × 180°] ÷ 6 = 120°

⇒ Interior angle of a regular 12-sided polygon = [(12 − 2) × 180°] ÷ 12

⇒ Interior angle of a regular 12-sided polygon = [10 × 180°] ÷ 12 = 150°

⇒ Ratio of their interior angles = 120° : 150°

⇒ Ratio = 12 : 15 = 4 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of an n-sided polygon is given by (n − 2) × 180°.

Exterior Angle of Regular Polygon

Each exterior angle of a regular n-sided polygon is given by 360° ÷ n. The sum of all exterior angles is always 360°.

Number of Diagonals

The total number of diagonals in an n-sided polygon can be calculated using the formula [n × (n − 3)] ÷ 2.
